name: Reconciliation: file content matches silver column-for-column
description: Every typed silver column is re-derived from the bronze worker_json and compared: zero field mismatches, identical worker sets, no promoted fields leaking into attributes, lineage intact.

assertions.name: zero_field_mismatches
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.raw_worker_events b JOIN silver.workers_current s ON s.worker_id = (b.worker_json ->> 'Worker_ID') AND s.source_file_id = b.file_id WHERE b.file_id = {file_id}::uuid AND (s.employee_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Employee_ID'), '') OR s.first_name IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'First_Name'), '') OR s.last_name IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Last_Name'), '') OR s.preferred_name IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Preferred_Name'), '') OR s.email IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Email'), '') OR s.worker_status IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Worker_Status'), '') OR s.job_profile IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Job_Profile'), '') OR s.job_family IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Job_Family'), '') OR s.department IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Department'), '') OR s.department_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Department_ID'), '') OR s.location IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Location'), '') OR s.country IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Country'), '') OR s.manager_worker_id IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Manager_Worker_ID'), '') OR s.cost_center IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Cost_Center'), '') OR s.employment_type IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Employment_Type'), '') OR s.worker_type IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Worker_Type'), '') OR s.time_type IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Time_Type'), '') OR s.compensation_grade IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Compensation_Grade'), '') OR s.currency IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(btrim(b.worker_json ->> 'Currency'), '') OR s.hire_date IS DISTINCT FROM silver.safe_date(b.worker_json ->> 'Hire_Date') OR s.termination_date IS DISTINCT FROM silver.safe_date(b.worker_json ->> 'Termination_Date') OR s.annual_salary IS DISTINCT FROM silver.safe_numeric(b.worker_json ->> 'Annual_Salary'))

assertions.name: worker_sets_match
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT worker_json ->> 'Worker_ID') FROM bronze.raw_worker_events WHERE file_id = {file_id}::uuid) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.workers_current WHERE worker_id LIKE {prefix} || '-W%')

assertions.name: no_promoted_fields_in_attributes
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.workers_current WHERE worker_id LIKE {prefix} || '-W%' AND attributes ?| ARRAY['First_Name','Department','Annual_Salary','Hire_Date']

assertions.name: all_rows_have_lineage
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.workers_current WHERE worker_id LIKE {prefix} || '-W%' AND source_file_id = {file_id}::uuid
